name: 14857-sharegpt-bamba9b-1gpu
model: ibm-ai-platform/Bamba-9B, served as `vllm serve ibm-ai-platform/Bamba-9B --dtype float16 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9`. Nothing is substituted.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, no parallelism flag; ~19.6 GB of float16 weights fits one card with room for the caches.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256 (this engine's max_num_seqs, so the scheduler is held exactly full), warmup 10%, no cooldown, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. Expect roughly 4-6 minutes of traffic plus model load.
workload: ShareGPT V3 unfiltered cleaned split, 1000 single-turn prompts at the corpus's own reply lengths, committed as `configs/data/sharegpt-1000-bamba.jsonl`. It totals 215201 prompt and 198343 output tokens; prompt tokens mean 215.2, p50 83, p90 621, max 997, output tokens mean 198.3, p50 145, p90 482, max 863 -- short and heavily skewed. Greedy decoding (temperature 0) and `request_format: plain`, a base checkpoint driven through a completions endpoint with max_tokens and ignore_eos taken from each row's output count, so the generated length is exactly the drawn one.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on a 9-billion-parameter model, answering 256 concurrent short conversational prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.8.1-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.
#
# Every key below is written out rather than inherited from the engine or the checkpoint,
# and none of them may be swept.
model: ibm-ai-platform/Bamba-9B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
max-model-len: 4096
enable-chunked-prefill: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
